A listing's or figure's definition

Source: R/lf.R
lf_rows.Rd

lf_rows() gives a report's rows of listings, listing_cols or figures; set_lf_rows() puts them back, edited. listing_types() are the listing types of the company standards (rtfreporter's).

Usage

lf_rows(x, sheet, output_id)

set_lf_rows(x, sheet, output_id, rows)

listing_types()

Arguments

x

A tflplanner.

sheet

listings, listing_cols or figures.

output_id

The report.

rows

The rows, edited.

Value

lf_rows(): a data frame; set_lf_rows(): the tflplanner; listing_types(): a data frame (type, label, note).
